expectedChanges: New isolated directory, minimal launcher and existing LAB registration; no main/oldLab changes or browser save I/O. Session memory and explicit JSON export only.

Actual current aroma-a generation, ageCask and bottle geometry for one live parent cask and frozen releases at different ages. Three flavor axes and two existing cask types. Prepared assets, not main save states; no full main copy.

Six explicitly fictional shops with taste, price band, quantity bounds and directed edges. Normal starter introductions town/station/super distinct from actual handling. Legal same-month20 comparison: town20 vs town5/station5/super10. Four cap>=20 origin probes; bar/dept smaller caps excluded from equal20 single-origin comparison, never relaxed.

Three modes: main-reference baseline without delivery spread, spread, spread+familiarity. Reuse actual main pure reputation/evidence/condition functions on isolated projection; retail-only evidence and previous-release bonus unchanged. Real three-store reference distinguished from fictional network. Default zero-retail baseline may have zero new offers; bounded established retail reference also inspected. Do not claim full native offer replay for six fictional shops.

Actual delivery consumes stock once and seeds finite provenance packets. Month reads frozen before-state, moves at most one edge, splits/decays weights with hop limit/no revisits. Frozen flavor affects paths, seeded variation deterministic; no total immunity. Offers/acceptance do not create stock or packets. Unknown/known/offered/accepted/actual handling distinct, decline nonblocking with eligibility/cooldown.

Familiarity derives from volume and distinct real delivery months, bounded and saturating. Same-month splitting cannot farm continuity or propagation. Continuing relationships have a visible consequence rather than an extra global gauge.

Compact pixel-inspired mobile UI: nodes/edges, selected frozen bottle/count/destination, monthly advance, offers accept/decline, live partial bottling, next recipe after cask ends, reset/seed/condition, optional reflections and JSON. Short provenance reasons, no numeric fame gauges.

Finite preset/seeds compare origins, same20 concentration/dispersion, flavors, three modes, genuine repeat and same-cask12/24/36 paths. Record timing/offers/continuity/types/next choices and failures. Do not retune to force fun, do not equate scalar reach with human motivation.
